---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new idea or enhancement for Trana
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Summary

A short, one-sentence summary of the feature you're proposing.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or gap this feature addresses. 
*Example: "As a paramedic, I find it difficult to log patient vitals while driving because..."*

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## How This Aligns with Trana's Mission

Explain how this feature supports one or more of Trana's core goals:
- [ ] Reducing ambulance response time
- [ ] Improving onboard equipment standards
- [ ] Improving hospital coordination / pre-arrival alerts
- [ ] Improving trust & safety (driver/paramedic verification)
- [ ] Other (please explain)

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you'd prefer your proposed approach.

## Relevant Phase of the Roadmap

Which phase does this feature relate to?
- [ ] Phase 1 — Research & Prototyping (UI/UX, partnerships)
- [ ] Phase 2 — Development & Alpha Testing (core build)
- [ ] Phase 3 — Pilot Launch
- [ ] Phase 4 — Optimization & Scaling
- [ ] General / Not phase-specific

## Mockups / References

If applicable, add wireframes, screenshots from similar apps, or links to reference implementations.

## Additional Context

Any other context, data, or edge cases that would help evaluate this feature.
